name.en: 3D concept design for a smaller furniture set

description.hr: Primjeri uključuju TV zid, zidnu oblogu, manji sklop namještaja i slične zahvate.
description.en: Examples include a TV wall, wall cladding, a small furniture set, and similar projects.

calculationNotes.hr: Početna cijena odnosi se na jednostavnije rješenje standardnog opsega. Dodatni opseg modeliranja obračunava se kroz dodatak za dodatnu složenost.
calculationNotes.en: The starting price applies to a simpler solution within a standard scope. Additional modelling scope is billed through the additional-complexity add-on.

description.hr: Primjeri uključuju kupaonicu, dječju sobu, spavaću sobu, dnevni boravak i slične prostorije.
description.en: Examples include a bathroom, children's room, bedroom, living room, and similar spaces.

calculationNotes.hr: Početna cijena odnosi se na jednostavnije rješenje standardnog opsega. Dodatni opseg modeliranja obračunava se kroz dodatak za dodatnu složenost.
calculationNotes.en: The starting price applies to a simpler solution within a standard scope. Additional modelling scope is billed through the additional-complexity add-on.

description.hr: Početna cijena odnosi se na jednostavniju kuhinju standardnog opsega — primjerice nekoliko donjih i nekoliko gornjih elemenata uz osnovnu logiku rasporeda. Dva ili tri samostalna elementa ne smatraju se kompletnom kuhinjom.
description.en: The starting price applies to a simpler kitchen within a standard scope — for example several base and several wall units with a straightforward layout. Two or three standalone elements are not considered a complete kitchen.

calculationNotes.hr: Dodatnu složenost mogu stvarati dodatni elementi, složenija unutarnja organizacija, skrivene ladice, posebna rješenja kutova, maske i drugi zahtjevi koji traže više modeliranja. Količina obračunskih jedinica ovisi o stvarnom dodatnom opsegu — nije povezana rigidno s brojem pojedinačnih elemenata.
calculationNotes.en: Additional complexity may come from extra elements, more complex internal organisation, hidden drawers, special corner solutions, panels, and other work that requires more modelling. The number of billing units depends on the actual additional scope — it is not tied rigidly to a count of individual elements.

description.hr: Dodatna usluga uz odobreno 3D idejno rješenje. Uključuje do 2 kadra iste prostorije i izrađuje se nakon odobrenja konačnog 3D modela.
description.en: An add-on to an approved 3D concept design. Includes up to 2 views of the same room and is produced after the final 3D model has been approved.

basis.en: for up to 2 views of the same room

name.en: Additional complexity for a 3D concept design

description.hr: Dodatak osnovnoj 3D usluzi, a ne samostalno idejno rješenje. Obračunska jedinica predstavlja dodatni opseg modeliranja i projektiranja iznad standardnog opsega osnovne usluge.
description.en: An add-on to a base 3D service, not a standalone concept design. Each billing unit represents additional modelling and design scope beyond the standard scope of the base service.

description.hr: Jedna manja korekcija uključena je u osnovnu cijenu 3D idejnog rješenja.
description.en: One minor revision is included in the base price of the 3D concept design.

description.hr: Primjenjuje se kada je potrebno bitno drugačije rješenje ili značajna promjena prethodno odobrenog koncepta. Cijena se određuje prema opsegu potrebnog rada.
description.en: Applies when a substantially different solution or a significant change to a previously approved concept is required. The price is determined according to the scope of work required.

description.hr: Popust se primjenjuje na ukupnu cijenu 3D projektiranja. Fotorealistične vizualizacije nisu dio osnovice za popust.
description.en: The discount applies to the total 3D design price. Photorealistic visualizations are excluded from the discount basis.

basis.en: on the total eligible 3D design price

label.hr: Paketni popust za projekt 4 ili više prostorija
label.en: Package discount for a project covering 4 or more rooms
